title: "Maker Movement" Approach to Computing; Interfaces as Art and Artifice
description: Create strange dashboards, haunted archives, unstable chatbots, broken forms, and other fictional digital systems in this one-credit creative studio course. Using Twine, you ll learn how links, screens, variables, and simple visual design can tell stories, create atmosphere, and make users feel like they are interacting with a living system. No programming experience is required - just bring curiosity, imagination, and an interest in how interfaces can shape emotion, agency, and meaning.
